annotations.title: Recorded sales and documents of a parcel

description: Every recorded sale and document of a parcel (transaction.sale, transaction.deed, debt.mortgage_recorded, debt.mortgage_satisfaction_recorded), newest first in registry_get's order, each a whole fact with its citation, a page at a time. registry_get keeps the newest 50 of them; when it holds more, its recorded_facts_truncated gives the totals, and this tool reads the rest. predicate limits the page to one of the four. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; next_cursor is null on the last. totals counts each predicate's facts. A price or amount is as recorded, zero or nominal included; the sources do not say whether a sale was at arm's length. Parties are organisations only. On the hosted API this tool needs a Pro or Team key. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
